title: M1: cluster-core crate (identity, pairing, protocol, registry, config, scheduler)
description:
crates/cluster-core: pure-logic crate (no I/O deps beyond std) with
identity, pairing FSM, wire codec, registry, config, scheduler scoring.
Unit tests everywhere.
CONTEXT: HerdCluster (Option B — pure wrapper, decided 2026-11-23) is a
STANDALONE Rust Cargo WORKSPACE that clusters coding agents across machines
WITHOUT herdr source code and WITHOUT modifying herdr. Canonical plan:
docs/herdcluster/PLAN.md.

CRATE LAYOUT (workspace, dependency direction is one-way, no cycles):
  crates/herdcluster    [[bin]] argv dispatch + CLI only (thin)
  crates/api-client     herdr NDJSON API client (socket discovery, request/
                        response, errors, compat guard, typed methods)
  crates/cluster-core   pure logic: identity(Ed25519), pairing FSM, wire
                        protocol codec, worker registry, config, scheduler
  crates/cluster-net    TLS1.3(rustls), stream mux, conn manager
                        (dial-out/heartbeat/reconnect), LAN discovery
  crates/cluster-bridge local unix socket <-> cluster stream <-> herdr API
                        socket proxy
  crates/cluster-fleet  global agent IDs, fan-out, agent ops, spawn composer
  crates/cluster-node   daemons: controller(init), worker(join/worker),
                        herdr runtime supervisor, resource monitor, doctor
RULE: herdcluster -> cluster-node/fleet/api-client -> bridge/net/core.
cluster-core depends on nothing internal. api-client standalone.

ARCHITECTURE: herdcluster speaks herdr's published API — newline-delimited
JSON (NDJSON) over a local socket: write serde_json(request)+"\n", read one
JSON line. Request = {id, method, params}; ~100 methods (agent.*, workspace.*,
pane.*, server.agent_manifests, status.server...). `agent.start` needs
pane_id+kind+name — spawn composes workspace.create -> pane -> agent.start.
Worker = herdcluster daemon that installs latest herdr RELEASE BINARY
(upstream herdrdev/herdr releases) and proxies cluster streams to the local
herdr API socket. Mac = controller (init). WSL2 = worker (join). UX target:
`init` / `join` / `doctor` with ZERO SSH/IP/key knowledge.

KEY FACTS (verified upstream, reference only — no source vendored):
- API socket path is platform-specific (unix socket / Windows named pipe),
  discoverable via herdr state dir; HERDR_SOCKET_PATH env override exists.
- Protocol version handshake via status.server; clients must guard mismatch.
- 22 agent kinds via server.agent_manifests.
- Upstream `machine add` SSH path proves release-asset auto-install pattern.

RULES: this repo contains ONLY original cluster code. Never vendor/copy herdr
source. Apache-2.0/MIT original code. Deps pinned, prefer versions >7 days old.
Worker dials OUT only (no inbound ports). Pairing tokens single-use/short-
lived. Agent CLI credentials are NEVER handled — detect + hint only.

title: Ed25519 cluster/worker identity module
description:
crates/cluster-core/src/identity.rs: generate/load/store Ed25519 keypairs
for cluster (controller) and worker identities under herdcluster state
dir. Fingerprint = first 16 hex of SHA-256(pubkey) — short human ID in
`machines`. Sign/verify challenge responses for post-pairing auth.
Files 0600, atomic writes, corrupt-file detection. Unit tests: keygen
roundtrip, tamper detection, fingerprint stability, wrong-key reject.

title: Pairing protocol state machine
description:
crates/cluster-core/src/pairing.rs: one-time 8-char code (Crockford-
style alphabet: no 0/O/1/I/L, ~40 bits), 5-min TTL, single-use,
constant-time compare, rate-limit (max 5 attempts -> 60s lockout,
confirm timeout 120s). States: AwaitingJoin -> PendingConfirm ->
Approved/Rejected/Expired. Controller confirm callback; worker wait
timeout. Pure FSM — inject clock + rng. Tests: expiry, replay, lockout,
confirm/deny, code entropy (no ambiguous chars).

title: Cluster wire protocol codec
description:
crates/cluster-core/src/protocol.rs: length-prefixed frames with
protocol_version field. Messages: PairHello/PairAccept/PairReject,
WorkerHello{pubkey,hostname,caps,resources,protocol_version},
ApiStreamOpen{stream_id}/ApiStreamData{stream_id,bytes}/
ApiStreamClose{stream_id,half_close}, Heartbeat{seq},
Resources{cpu_cores,mem_total_mb,mem_available_mb,agent_count,
max_agents,load_avg,kinds[]}, Event{kind,payload}. Stream 0 = control;
data streams carry raw herdr API bytes, per-stream ordering guaranteed,
half-close propagates FIN. Property tests: roundtrip, truncation/garbage,
16MiB frame cap, version mismatch reject.

title: Worker registry schema + persistence
description:
crates/cluster-core/src/registry.rs + state layout: cluster.json
{cluster_id,name,port,protocol_version,created_at}; workers.json
{version,workers:[{worker_id,label,pubkey,paired_at,last_seen,status,

HerdCluster-owned — do NOT touch herdr's endpoint catalog. Tests:
migration, corruption, concurrent update safety.

title: Scheduler scoring (pure logic)
description:

WorkerCaps{online,enabled,kinds[],agent_count,max_agents,mem_available_mb,
label} + request{kind,machine_hint} -> Option<placement> or rejection
reasons per machine. Filter online+kind+under-cap; score mem headroom/
slot -> lowest agent_count -> label (deterministic). Local machine is
just another WorkerCaps. Exhaustive unit tests over fixture sets.
